reason: A is more specific and falsifiable, defining defect/oxygen interventions, temperature-dependent mechanisms, quantitative improvements over ideal-crystal models, applicability limits, and benchmark temperatures. Although its error targets are somewhat arbitrary and it should explicitly reserve conductivity data as a held-out test—and clarify that electronic transport calculations, not merely interatomic potentials, provide relaxation times—it is substantially more testable than B’s largely qualitative, calibration-dependent proposal.
